title: San Moritz Lodge

services.name: Activites & Rentals
services.desc: Children 3 and under get in FREE! Annual pass requires 12 Month Commitment. All memberships are priced per person. Minors must be supervised by an adult at all times. Waterpark activities available to purchase online in advance Boat rentals available to reserve online in advance. Same-day inquiries must book at boathouse. Beach Access, Splash Pad, Water Slides, and Inflatable Splash Islands are seasonally available. Please be aware, by utilizing the facilities at the Lake Gregory Regional Park in Crestline, California, you consent to your likeness being used for promotional purposes in all media by the Lake Gregory Community Recreation Company LLC, and San Bernardino County Regional Parks

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Rental includes tables, chairs, and set up for these items. Contract time frame must include setup and teardown of any outside items brought in. A credit card is required to be on file for damages and cleaning fees. Only LGCRC-preferred vendors have access to the lodge kitchen. All alcohol must be purchased through our preferred alcohol

explain.meaning: Entry for one day, coming and going as you like.

services.name: Fishing Passes
services.desc: d one of the best trout fishing spots in Southern California, Lake Gregory is the perfect place to cast a line and enjoy the day. Happy fishing! Stop by our Bait + Tackle Shop before you hit the water! We offer a great selection of bait, tackle, fishing equipment, snacks, drinks, and gear from local vendors. You can also rent rods, boats, and more-all in one convenient spot at the lake. Make the most of your time on the water with a fishing boat rental at Lake Gregory. Walk-up rentals are available at our Bait & Tackle Shop, though availability is limited. For a guaranteed spot, book your boat online through our Boathouse, open daily from 10 AM to 5 PM. San Bernardino County regulations
